svg.text: DIMENSIONLESS • CANDIDATE TOPOLOGY • NOT A PRODUCTION MODEL
Intake, longitudinal rail and output have x=0 centerline.
Both end portals face the same axis; no side exit.
Reference proportions only. Authoritative 4x4 occupancy and real unit clearance not established.
Author: Angelis Pseftis • All views project the same vertices; view framing scales independently.
